Choppertown.us: Pizza, Hook-ups, and a Suspicious Suitcase. Matt and Froy disrupt a couple's tryst, repo a car from a pizzeria, then face challenges at a car graveyard.
Exterminate or Retaliate. Lou orchestrates a truck ambush. Then, they repo a tractor and confront punk kids for four wheelers.
Unwanted Seizures. Lou orders a Toyota repo post-divorce, has Froy and Matt tail another, and aids a seizing debtor.
Pepper Spray and Guns. First, Froy and Sonia douse a couple with a dose of pepper spray when the debtor gets too pushy with Sonia.

Legal Repossession. Matt, Froy, & Lou repo attorney's car. Froy, Lyndah, & Sonia interrupt scene. Lou & Sonia handle ATVs.
Business Issues. Sonia and Lou deal with a terrible boss and his instigating employees.
Wrench in the Works. A wrench is thrown in the works, and at the car, when Froy and Matt try to repo from a plumber.
Hidden Cars and Higher Powers. Matt and Froy get some help from a friendly gardener that lead them to discover a car hidden in the backyard.
Rolling Away. Lou, Sonia, and Froy have to push away a debtor while trying to push a classic car up a hill.
Matt's Back. Froy & Mike repo at paintball range. Matt intervenes. Sonia & Froy repo sedan. Matt & Lou take risky job.
Burgers, Bottles, and Hustlers. Lou & Sonia repo from gangsta gals. Matt & Froy dispute with burger-slinger. Sonia & Froy face hustler & crew.

Role-players and Blade Swayers. Lou, Matt, & Froy face owner with blade. Matt & Froy reclaim Prius from role-players.

Honor Rolling Away. Sonia & Lyndah confront student. Matt & Sonia face armed thugs. Lou & Sonia repo Escalade from couple.
Tazed and Amazed. Matt & Froy call cops for old-timer. Lou & Froy clash with bowler. Froy & Lyndah deal with Altima owner.
Intoxicated Marina Idiots. Lou & Sonia pursue Porsche & Audi. Matt & Froy recover truck. Matt & Lou seize BMW from rich couple.
Playing the Role. Lou devises a plan to have Froy and Sonia pose as house buyers.
Broken Bones and Broken Phones. Froy, Lou & Matt face bodybuilders for Jeep. Lou & Lyndah startle broker. Froy learns text lesson from Sonia.
The Hearse Isn't Empty?. Matt & Lou handle accountant & son. Sonia & Froy manage pool party. They chase a hearse.
Froy Gets Beat Up. Sonia & Lou encounter economy impact. Matt & Sonia deal with spoiled princess and unpaid bill on Jetta.
This Is No Fantasy. Froy & Lyndah handle bride. Matt intervenes with players. Sonia, Lyndah, Froy, & Lou tackle flaming car.
The Missing RV and the Private Jet. Lou, Sonia, and Froy find an RV missing for 30 years, now used by young Canadian rock stars.
Pyramid Scams and Princesses. Lou, Sonia, and Matt face tough truckers; Lyndah and Lou expose a scam; the team confronts a club princess.
Jet Skis and Massages. The team repos jet skis at the beach, confronts a skilled masseuse, and unknowingly pulls a costly prank.
Get That Prowler. Lou, Sonia, and Froy repo a taxicab with a drunk client, while Matt and Froy repo a stuck-in-the-80s DeLorean.
Up Up and Away. Lou, Froy, and Matt tackle two hot air balloons, repo a sports car, and handle graffiti girls with Frankie.

DeadlyWomen.us: Dangerous Liaisons. Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

Young Blood. Sometimes the innocence of childhood is swept away by dark thoughts and violent currents. Deep and disturbing psychological impulses will drive a child to kill another child.

Teen Killers. They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?
